4. **P2 — OAuth URL composition corrupts existing query parameters.**  
   [oauth.ex:22](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/provider/oauth.ex:22)

   The helper always adds `"?"`. With endpoint `https://provider.test/auth?tenant=one`, it produces:

   ```text
   https://provider.test/auth?tenant=one?client_id=client&state=state
   ```

   Parsing this URL puts `?client_id=client` inside the tenant value. The `client_id` parameter is absent. Google and Microsoft expose endpoint overrides, so callers can reach this case.

   **Correction:** filter blank values, then use the existing `Http.url_with_query/2`. Add a test with an existing query.

Acceptance: Reproduce the reported case against current source, apply the smallest correction described above, and add focused verification of both the failing case and supported behavior. For documentation/design work, update the public contract and verify its examples/callers. Preserve tenant, scope, lease, and host ownership boundaries. Use fresh matching v3 dependencies for final verification; saved local v2 build artifacts do not establish v3 conformance.

Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Full source review and its coverage/verification limits are preserved in the parent epic comments.
title: OAuth URL composition corrupts existing query parameters
